threshold_rationale: The original +5,000 was calibrated before the 2026-09-30 stock governance, which deliberately traded count for quality (1,902 duplicate-sense merges and 514 traditional-split merges permanently removed from the publishable count). Those removals held an implicit share of the original threshold. The corrected criterion is a net gain of 2,000 publishable senses over the live online D1 release with every deterministic and model gate green. Baseline counts and published_at were read directly from the live D1 v2_meta and table counts on 2026-10-09 (the repo baseline file had been stale at the 2026-08-24 v178 release).
